answer: The nebula of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, held in escrow until finality, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the grove of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the haven re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
